lines.en: The giant butterfly passes under the canopy.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扇得很慢很重
lines.en: Its wings beat slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 翅影在地上扫过一大片
lines.en: Its wing shadow sweeps a wide patch.
It rounds a hanging vine.

lines.zh: 它飞得不快，却很有压迫感
lines.en: It is not fast, and it feels heavy.
It glances down and rises.

lines.zh: 它的翅边在光里发暗红
lines.en: Its wing edges show dark red.

lines.zh: 它绕着一棵大树转了半圈
lines.en: It loops half around a large tree.

lines.zh: 它落在一片宽叶上，压弯了
lines.en: It lands on a broad leaf and bends it.
It pauses, then lifts off.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向压低高度
lines.en: It drops its height your way.

lines.zh: 它的翅风把你的衣服吹动
lines.en: Its wingbeat stirs your clothes.
It runs a stretch alongside a trunk.

lines.zh: 它的翅扇开垂下来的气根
lines.en: Its wings push the hanging roots aside.
It passes through a shaft of light.
It skims low over a fern clump.
The giant butterfly rests by its cocoon, wings closed.

lines.zh: 它的翅纹像一对睁开的眼
lines.en: The pattern on its wings looks like open eyes.
Its antennae turn slowly.
Its wingtips quiver.

lines.zh: 它在宽叶上换了个姿势
lines.en: It shifts on the broad leaf.
The leaf bows under it.

lines.zh: 它的口器卷着，没有伸出
lines.en: Its proboscis stays coiled.
It half opens its wings.
A little wing dust falls.
It slowly folds them again.

lines.zh: 它把翅完全合拢，藏起颜色
lines.en: It shuts its wings and hides its colours.
Only a rim of dark red shows.
The giant butterfly spreads its wings at you.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑直直看着你
lines.en: The eyespots stare straight at you.
It looks you over.
It rises half a block and circles.
Then it settles back on the leaf.

lines.zh: 它似乎不觉得你有威胁
lines.en: It does not seem to find you a threat.
Its wings open once more.
Wider this time.
It turns its head away.
The wings fold back.
The giant butterfly's flight lists.
It sheds a patch of wing dust.
It climbs away, wings still spread.
A gash opens along its wing edge.
It lands and folds slowly.
Its antennae lower.
It tries to fly and hitches.
It turns itself side-on.
Its wings open once more.
It does not manage to fly far either.

lines.zh: 巨蝶朝你手上的东西飞来
lines.en: The giant butterfly flies at what you hold.
It rounds you twice.
It lands and unrolls its proboscis.
It feeds; its wings tremble.
Finished, it coils the proboscis up.

lines.zh: 它对你手里的花更有兴趣
lines.en: Flowers interest it more than food.
It lands on your wrist.
It is heavier than you expected.
It rests a while, then leaves.
It flies off and loops back.
The giant butterfly hits your shoulder, heavy.
Its wingbeat rocks you.
It backs half a block and steadies.
Wing dust smears your clothes.
It carves an arc past your side.
It lands on a nearby branch.
It watches, wings still open.
Then it folds them slowly.
It has not flown from here.
It has only shifted to a new spot.
Two giant butterflies circle in flight.
One rises as the other falls.
Their shadows cross beneath the trees.
They land on the same branch.
Their wing edges press almost flush.
Two antennae meet in one place.
Then both spread their wings at once.

lines.zh: 两对眼斑一起对着外面
lines.en: Two pairs of eyespots face outward.
Wing dust floats in the light.
The branch stays quiet a long while.
The giant butterfly lands and unrolls its beak.
The proboscis goes into the flower's heart.
It feeds until its wings stop beating.
It moves to another bloom.
A flower it is not, so it will not touch it.
It returns to your hand.
It spreads its wings to bask.
Then it coils the proboscis away.
Its take-off throws a gust.
It heads for the canopy.

lines.zh: 巨蝶的翅一下全张开了
lines.en: The giant butterfly flares its wings.
Every eyespot turns on you.
It rises above your head.

lines.zh: 它的翅影把你整个罩住
lines.en: Its shadow covers you entirely.
It starts pressing down.
The wingbeat flattens the grass.
Its whole body pulls taut.

lines.zh: 它的触角朝前伸得笔直
lines.en: Its antennae point straight ahead.
It seems to have grown angry.

lines.zh: 翅边那道暗红更明显了
lines.en: The dark red on its wing edges deepens.
The giant butterfly circles overhead.
Each pass drops it a notch lower.
Its eyespots stay on you.
It is hunting a gap.
It lands on a branch behind you.
Then lifts off silently.

lines.zh: 它的翅风扫过你的后颈
lines.en: The wingbeat brushes your nape.
You turn; it is on the other side.
It tests a wing sweep at you.
That was only a probe.
The giant butterfly's wing sweeps your face.
It strikes your chest, heavily.

lines.zh: 它的翅边刮过你的手臂
lines.en: A wing edge rakes your arm.
It bears down from above.
Its proboscis jabs at your hand.
Wing dust blinds you.
It withdraws and rushes back.
It shoves you back with its body.

lines.zh: 它的翅风把你吹得站不稳
lines.en: The wingbeat unbalances you.

lines.zh: 它落在地上，慢慢爬过来
lines.en: It lands and crawls at you.
A patch of shade appears under the canopy.
The giant butterfly drops through the leaves.

lines.zh: 它的翅张开时比人还宽
lines.en: Its wings open wider than a person.
Wing dust scatters in the light.
It circles the cocoon once.
Then it rises among the branches.
Its eyespots face outward.
It settles on a broad leaf.
The leaf bows low.
It turns its head to you.

lines.zh: 翅边被燎卷，它急急升高
lines.en: Fire curls a wing edge and it climbs fast.
Its wings crumple on landing.

lines.zh: 翅沾水，它飞得又低又慢
lines.en: Wet wings keep it low and slow.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀得撞上树干
lines.en: The blast throws it into a trunk.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅面，留下一个洞
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through a wing.
Odd force spins it in a tight circle.
Long unfed, its flight wanders.
Lightning locks it in midair.

lines.zh: 虚空一吸，它的翅扇不动了
lines.en: The void pulls and its wings cannot beat.
